items.evidence: The preposition 'by' is used to indicate a deadline (by Friday).
An adverb ('efficiently') is needed to modify the verb 'works'.
Modal verb 'must' is followed by a base verb ('register').
'Since' is used with the present perfect tense to indicate a starting point in time ('2022').
A singular noun ('discount') is required after the article 'a'.
'Because' introduces a clause expressing the reason for the postponement.
The verb 'encourage' takes an infinitive with 'to' in the passive structure ('are encouraged to provide').
A plural noun ('requirements') is needed after the possessive pronoun 'our'.
First conditional sentence structure uses 'If + present simple' ('arrives'), followed by 'will + verb' ('will inspect') in the main clause.
The past time marker 'yesterday' combined with the passive subject 'The documents' requires the past passive form ('were reviewed').
